channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: BOJ’s Faster ETF Sales May Help Takaichi’s Spending Plan
item.description: The Bank of Japan’s decision to accelerate sales of exchange-traded funds could boost its payments to the government, potentially helping Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi finance her costly policy agenda.
item.dc:creator: Takashi Umekawa and Erica Yokoyama

item.title: Rubio and Brazil Foreign Minister to Meet After Election Tension
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio and his Brazilian counterpart agreed to meet in the coming weeks, according to people familiar with the matter, after President Donald Trump’s decision to grant the nation’s defeated right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro refuge inflamed tensions.
item.dc:creator: Eric Martin and Augusta Saraiva

item.title: Australian PM Set to Visit Beijing After APEC Meeting, SCMP Says
item.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is set to visit Beijing next month, seeking to stabilize the nations’ relationship, the South China Morning Post reported, citing unidentified people.
item.dc:creator: Bei Hu

item.title: Chocolate Price Spook Families for Halloween
item.description: Halloween candy is getting more expensive as higher labor, energy and transportation costs continue to pressure food prices. Stew Leonard Jr., CEO of Stew Leonard’s, says bags of popular candy are up about 50 cents from last year, prompting some shoppers to trade down to cheaper options. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how affordability is changing consumer behavior, and how both environmental and economic changes are impacting the business. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Crypto Hack Reignites Regulatory Debate
item.description: A $6 billion crypto hack is putting digital-asset security back in the spotlight. Former CFTC chairman J. Christopher Giancarlo, known as “CryptoDad”, argues the attack exposed vulnerabilities at an individual firm rather than a failure of underlying blockchain technology. He is also calling for the US to take a more aggressive approach to state-sponsored cyberattacks. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the fallout from the hack and why he believes prediction markets should be regulated federally by the CFTC rather than by individual states. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Lonnie Ali & Marc Rosen on New Muhammad Ali Amazon Show
item.description: Lonnie Ali, Muhammad Ali's wife & Executive Producer of The Greatest, joins Marc Rosen of Authentic Brands to discuss the first authorized scripted series to take a more intimate look at Muhammad Ali beyond his boxing career. The two speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bloomberg Screentime: Streaming, AI & Creators
item.description: Entertainment leaders examine how streaming, AI, and the creator economy are reshaping Hollywood and the future of media. Guests include Ted Sarandos, Donna Langley, Ben Affleck, & Conan O'Brien. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: PacSun CEO: Brands Mean a Lot to Young People Today
item.description: Brieane Olson, CEO of PacSun, says that the retailer’s core customer is 16 to 24, while it is also tracking differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Drawing on a PacSun Youth Report conducted with GlobalData and surveying 6,000 young people, Olson said mental health ranks as their top priority. She cited PACSUN’s ongoing partnership with Selena Gomez and the Rare Impact Foundation as an example of collaborations intended to have lasting value for young customers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: New Balance CEO Joe Preston on NYC Marathon Partnership
item.description: Joe Preston, New Balance President and CEO, discussed the company’s long-running partnership with the New York City Marathon, which he described as a key part of the brand. More than 300 New Balance associates are in the city for race week, including 200 retail staff at the Javits Center expo, where more than 100,000 visitors are expected over three days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Ice Cube on Big3 League: In a Great Position To Scale
item.description: Ice Cube, CEO & Co-Founder of the Big3 basketball league, says audiences want more basketball in the summer and argues that the league has helped professionalize three-on-three play. He describes basketball as a globally beloved sport and say the league is well positioned to grow, noting that it is already recognized as the world’s premier professional three-on-three league. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Burger King US President on Sales Turnaround
item.description: Burger King US and Canada President Tom Curtis discussed the chain’s comparable-sales growth, cited in the conversation as 8.4%, against an estimate of 6.2%. Curtis said growth is being driven largely by customers who had stopped visiting and are now returning, drawn by a renewed connection to the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rich Steinmeier on a Career in Management
item.description: Barry speaks with Rich Steinmeier, CEO of LPL Financial. They discuss his early career learnings at McKinsey. They also discuss LPL's $2.7 billion acquisition of Commonwealth, and the evolving relationship of AI and financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: The Future of Financial Advice: Masters in Business with Rich Steinmeier
item.description: Barry speaks with Rich Steinmeier, CEO of LPL Financial. They discuss his early career learnings at McKinsey. They also discuss LPL's $2.7 billion acquisition of Commonwealth, and the evolving relationship of AI and financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Brazil Summons Argentine Envoy Over Role in Bolsonaro’s Escape
item.description: Brazilian authorities summoned Argentina’s top envoy in the country on Friday to explain President Javier Milei’s role in helping Flávio Bolsonaro flee Brazil following his election defeat.
item.dc:creator: Augusta Saraiva

item.title: Wall Street Boom to Cut New York State Budget Deficit in Half
item.description: New York projected the budget deficit will narrow by $3.5 billion next year as the state expects a boom in trading and borrowing to deliver record profits to Wall Street and stronger bonus payments to boost revenue.
item.dc:creator: Martin Z. Braun

item.title: Hedge Funds Boost Natural Gas Short Positions to Most on Record
item.description: Hedge funds this week amassed the largest-ever short position on US natural gas on expectations that an unusually warm winter will slash demand for the furnace and power-plant fuel.
item.dc:creator: Julian Hast

item.title: Brazil Hedge Funds Reel as Losses Reach 24% After Lula Shock
item.description: In the span of three weeks, Brazilian hedge-fund managers went from celebrating some of their biggest gains in years to nursing steep losses and issuing mea culpas to their clients.
item.dc:creator: Barbara Nascimento, Leda Alvim and Vinícius Andrade

item.title: Investor Looks to Bid on Club Pilates-Owner Xponential
item.description: Fund 1 Investments LLC, the third-largest shareholder in Xponential Fitness Inc., the owner of Club Pilates and Pure Barre brands, said it’s pushing for a take-private and is looking to buy the company itself.
item.dc:creator: Liana Baker

item.title: Wall Street Turns Ruthless as Earnings Misses Fuel Deep Selloffs
item.description: Equity investors are meting out some of the harshest punishments ever for companies that miss expectations, just as strategists sound the alarm that earnings growth has likely peaked.
item.dc:creator: Geoffrey Morgan

item.title: Stocks Slump as Wall Street Gets AI Wake-Up Call: Markets Wrap
item.description: Wall Street got a reality check as a bruising selloff in technology shares fueled concern the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has powered the equity bull market might be overblown.
item.dc:creator: Rita Nazareth
